programmes.title: Loyalty programme
programmes.subtitle: How your customers earn. Choose one primary programme, configure it and switch it when you need to.

setup.title: Choose your loyalty programme
setup.intro: Pick how customers earn at your business. You can change it later.
setup.laterNote: Customers can still join, but they earn nothing until you activate a programme.

none.title: No loyalty programme is active
none.body: Customers can join and be served, but they earn nothing until you activate a programme below.

choose.title: Choose a programme
choose.body: Select a programme to configure it. Nothing starts until you confirm the activation.

switch.body: Pick a different programme to prepare it. It only replaces the current one when you confirm its activation.

reason.IN_DEVELOPMENT: Not available yet: this programme is still being built.
reason.NEEDS_ITEM_LEVEL_EVIDENCE: Not available yet: it needs verified item-level purchase data, which the platform does not capture yet.
reason.NEEDS_OWNER_DECISION: Not available yet: it needs a platform decision first.

LP-01.name: Buy X, get Y free
LP-01.summary: Customers collect a stamp for each eligible purchase; a completed card earns a free item.
LP-01.example: Example: buy 4 coffees and the 5th is free.
LP-01.needs: Needs: stamps per card, a free-item reward and how stamps expire.

LP-02.name: Fixed points per purchase
LP-02.summary: Every qualifying purchase earns the same number of points, whatever it costs.
LP-02.example: Example: every qualifying purchase earns 10 points.
LP-02.needs: Needs: points per purchase and an optional minimum amount.

LP-03.name: Spend and earn
LP-03.summary: Customers earn points in proportion to what they spend.
LP-03.example: Example: every 1 KWD spent earns 10 points.

LP-04.name: Milestone rewards
LP-04.summary: Customers unlock rewards when they reach purchase, visit or spending milestones.
LP-04.example: Example: complete 20 qualifying visits to unlock a reward.
LP-04.needs: Needs: a milestone type, ascending thresholds and a reward for each.

LP-05.name: Streak rewards
LP-05.summary: Customers earn a reward for qualifying activity in consecutive days or weeks.
LP-05.example: Example: visit on five consecutive days.
LP-05.needs: Needs: the period, how many in a row and a reward. Uses your business timezone.

LP-06.name: Off-peak rewards
LP-06.summary: Bonus points for purchases made in the quiet times you choose.
LP-06.example: Example: extra points between 2 PM and 5 PM.
LP-06.needs: Needs: weekdays, time windows (business local time) and a bonus.

LP-07.name: Missions and challenges
LP-07.summary: Short challenges with a deadline and a reward.
LP-07.example: Example: complete 3 qualifying purchases within 7 days.
LP-07.needs: Needs: an objective, a target, a deadline and a reward.

LP-08.name: Product-specific loyalty
LP-08.example: Example: buy five bakery products to earn a reward.
LP-08.needs: Needs verified item-level purchase data, which is not available yet.

active.legacyNote: This programme reproduces the earning your business already had. Changing it creates a new version that applies only to future purchases.
